thread:
Noah (Finance): Quick flag for deal desk: Oxbridge Health (EMEA reseller) asking for a bespoke pilot concession. Ask: 22% usage credit on partner-billed volume + net60, ability to invoice in GBP/EUR (they'll collect in GBP but end-customers in EU), and VAT passthrough. Need finance + legal + revops signoff.

Zara (Sales): Short context: 5-month pilot aimed at 4 hospital trusts in UK/IE, starting 2026-11-01. Estimated usage ~140k tokens/mo ramping to 480k. They want the credit to subsidize onboarding + local compliance certs. No firm long-term commit yet, but high intent to convert.

Priyanka (RevOps): Ops constraints: (1) cap total credit to GBP 18,000, (2) limit credits to partner master account mapping (explicit end-customer list), (3) 90-day clawback window if an end-customer cancels, prorated. We need a Zuora ticket to create `partner_pilot_credit_gbp` with recognition rule and multi-currency support.

Marco (Legal): I'll draft a one-page addendum. Need to define: "usage credit" (percentage of gross usage on Redwood invoice to partner), currency of cap (GBP vs EUR conversion), exact clawback formula, and VAT reps. Also add audit rights and a short indemnity for misreported usage.

Ellen (CFO): Net60 increases DSO. Conditional approval: require (A) 40% holdback on credits until month 2, (B) partner credit check + two trade refs, (C) currency conversion rule locked at invoice creation (no retro FX adjustments). Also want an exposure note if we accept GBP invoices but report in USD books.

Noah (Finance): Accounting guidance: treat credits as contra-revenue and amortize monthly across pilot term. Priyanka, can Zuora handle holdback + a currency-specific cap? Also need a billing workflow if invoice is unpaid at day 45.

Priyanka (RevOps): Yes. I'll open ZOA-12077 to create `partner_pilot_credit_gbp` with cap GBP18,000 and a 40% holdback until month 2, plus mapping to partner account and end-customer IDs. I'll also add an AR escalation workflow at day 45 to ping Sales + Finance.

Zara (Sales): Oxbridge shared VAT ID and two trade refs via email to me. They prefer invoices in GBP. I'll request confirmation on the conversion rule for the cap (GBP-denominated cap to avoid FX drift).

Marco (Legal): Draft addendum uploaded to deal OBX-210. Key clauses: 22% usage credit up to GBP18k, pilot 2026-11-01 to 2027-03-01, clawback within 90 days prorated, reseller VAT reps + OSS proof for 0% VAT if requested, audit right 12 months. Sending to Zara for signature routing.

billing-bot: Created Zuora ticket ZOA-12077 and linked to OBX-210.

Ellen (CFO): Conditional approval recorded. Final sign-off after: signed addendum, ZOA-12077 implemented with 40% holdback, and credit-check complete. If any fail revert to Net30 and remove the pilot credit.

Noah (Finance): Approve in principle. Final approval will be posted here once RevOps confirms ticket and Legal confirms signed addendum. Keep updates to this thread only.

Zara (Sales): I'll route the addendum to Oxbridge today and post signer confirmation + trade ref screenshots here when done. ETA 48h. Thanks all :thumbsup:
